headings.description: Used for all page titles, section headers, and data labels. Gives a structured, official, yet modern feel. BANNED: Inter, Roboto.

body.description: Highly readable, excellent for academic forms, tables, and dense data.

primary.description: Universitas Terbuka Official Blue. Use for primary actions, active states, header accents, and key highlights.

background.description: Very subtle cool gray/off-white for the app background to make the crisp white worksheet cards pop.

layouts.dashboard: Sidebar layout with a top header. The main content area should have a max-width and generous padding (p-6 md:p-12). Focus on functional data display.
layouts.worksheet_form: The Lembar Kerja should look like a digitized official document. Use a central paper-like container with max-w-5xl mx-auto, shadow-sm, border border-slate-200, bg-white, and p-8 md:p-12. Divide sections clearly with H3 titles, solid 1px dividers, and numbering.
layouts.spacing: Follow 'Generous Spacing Philosophy'. Use gap-8 or gap-12 between major form sections. Use gap-4 for related fields.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid crisp borders. Avoid heavy drop shadows; use shadow-sm for cards. Focus rings should be 2px solid #404080 with a 2px offset.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use only on the sticky top navigation (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200).
visual_enhancers.corners: Subtle roundness. Use rounded-md (6px) or rounded-lg (8px). Do not use fully rounded pills for form inputs to maintain the academic tone.

components.buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Primary buttons use bg-[#404080] text-white hover:bg-[#29166F] transition-colors. Add micro-interactions like active:scale-[0.98].
components.inputs: Shadcn standard but styled with focus:border-[#404080] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#404080]. Background white.
components.tables: Crucial for the Schedule Matrix. Use clear border-collapse layouts with border-slate-200. Table headers should have a subtle bg-[#EAEAF2] with text-[#404080] font-semibold. Cells must be padded nicely (p-3).
components.cards: Flat, 1px border, minimal shadows. Keep it looking like academic paper.
components.alerts: Use thin left borders (border-l-4 border-[#404080]) for info boxes and instructions.

image_urls.description: Modern glass building reflecting older architecture, great for the login page split screen (50% width on desktop).
Student studying, use as an optional welcoming banner image inside the dashboard area to add human element.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use default Inter font. Import and apply 'Chivo' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body/tables.

Ensure the 'Lembar Kerja' form is not one massive scrolling list of inputs without hierarchy. Group them visually into logical sections mimicking an official physical worksheet. Sections: 1. Identitas, 2. Tujuan & Target, 3. Tabel Mata Kuliah, 4. Jadwal Per Semester, 5. SQ3R, 6. Peta Konsep.
For the 'Jadwal Belajar Per Semester' and 'Target Mingguan', use robust data tables (HTML table or Shadcn Table) with clear borders to resemble a matrix.
The SQ3R sections (Survey, Questions, Read, Recite, Review) should be distinctly separated, perhaps using distinct numbered cards or left-bordered blocks to guide the student.
Add a PDF export button at the top or bottom of the worksheet view. Ensure print styles or PDF generation logic focuses on layout clarity.
Admin panel should be a dense data-table view to list all student worksheets, easily filterable by NIM or Name.
Never use AI placeholders for logos. Just use text 'UNIVERSITAS TERBUKA' in Chivo font with the official #404080 color.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='worksheet-form').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered text alignment globally.
Apply precise padding (e.g., p-8 or p-12) to containers; avoid cramped spaces.
Use standard hover and focus states for all interactive elements to ensure accessibility.
Include specific CSS transitions for color, background, and transform (e.g., transition-colors duration-200), do not use 'transition-all'.
Do not over-engineer components. Stick to Shadcn UI fundamentals combined with pure Tailwind structure for complex sections.
accessibility: Maintain WCAG AA contrast, especially for text on the official blue background.
All form fields must have visible labels and aria-labels where appropriate.
Focus rings must be distinctly visible for keyboard navigation.
